definition: a looting of otheṛs goods, valuables, etc. secretly.
example: ಆ ಸೇವಕ ಮನೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಒಳಲೂಟಿ ನಡೆಸಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಬಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That servant was caught secretly looting the house.

definition: development, improvement or refinement of the intellect, emotions, interests, manners, and taste; culture.
example_en: Education develops a person's culture.

definition: to remove a dent or dents (of a metal vessel) by hammering.
example_en: He hammered out the dent in the vessel and fixed it.

definition: the act or an instance of striving in competition with another; a competition; a contention for superiority.
example: ಇಬ್ಬರ ನಡುವೆ ಪರಪಱಿಸುಹ ದಿನದಿಂದ ದಿನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The contention for superiority between the two was increasing day by day.

definition: charming beauty; gracefulness.
example_en: The temple's charming beauty attracted the onlookers.

definition: a group of students studying the same branch of knowledge.
example_en: The study group conducted research under the professor.

definition: the act or sound of coughing.
example_en: He was coughing because of the cold.

definition: (a liquid) to flow down continuously and forcefully.
example_en: Rainwater flowed down forcefully from the roof.

definition: a bridge suspended from chains or cables which are anchored at either end and supported by towers at regular intervals and having no support from below at all; a suspension bridge.
example: ನದಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ತೂಗುಸೇತುವೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a beautiful suspension bridge over the river.

definition: to shut the twin doors amaḷgada.
example_en: As night fell, he shut the twin doors.

definition: the tree Sapindus emarginatus of Sapindaceae family; the soapnut tree.
example_en: People wash clothes with the fruits of the soapnut tree.

definition: a house where dirty clothes are washed in boiling water and washing soda (sodium carbonate).
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಹೊಲಸು ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ಉಬ್ಬೆಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುದಿಸಿ ಒಗೆಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: The grandmother boils and washes the dirty clothes in the washing house.

definition: attached with; fastened to.
example_en: This pipe is attached to the tank.

definition: the act of confessing; acknowledgement; esp. a) an admission of guilt, b) a general acknowledgment of sin, wrongs committed.
example_en: The accused made a confession of guilt in the court.

definition: a single hand.
example_en: He pulled the rope with just a single hand.

definition: to go in a circumbulating path or manner.
example: ಅವನು ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಸುತ್ತುಬಳಸು ಮಾಡಿ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He went circling around the hill and came back.

definition: any bacterial toxin mixed with one's food with the intention of causing sickness; food-poison.
example_en: The doctors identified that food-poison had been mixed into the food.

definition: the act of delaying; procrastination; delay.
example_en: The delaying of the work annoyed everyone.

definition: a sub-caste among weavers.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪದ್ಮಸಾಲೆ ಸಮುದಾಯದವರು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: People of the Padmasale sub-caste are found in large numbers in that town.

definition: a kind of creeper.
example_en: The haḍada creeper grew at the edge of the forest.

definition: to pull; to draw.
example_en: He pulled the rope with force.

definition: infallibly; effectively.
example_en: His plan succeeded infallibly.

definition: to get (esp. money) by insistence, imploring or servile etc.
example_en: He got money from the poor by insistence.

definition: impossible to be seen; imperceptible by the sense of sight; not seen; invisible.
example_en: People believe that god is invisible.

definition: a plant having a permanently woody main stem or trunk ordinarily growing to a considerable height, and usu. developing branches at some distance from the ground; a tree.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಚಾಡ ನಿಂತಿದೆ.
example_en: A big tree stands in front of the house.

definition: the right or left part of a human or animal body (as the arm, shoulder, flank, etc.).
example_en: He had great pain in the injured flank of his body.

definition: an upper floor in a building.
example_en: There is a library on the upper floor of this building.

definition: (fig.) the quality of a mean person or a cheat; a dishonest mind.
example_en: Many people were cheated because of his dishonest mind.

definition: the act of cancelling, repealing, revoking; cancellation; repeal.
example_en: The repeal of the old law was announced in the meeting.

definition: the state of being reversed.
example: ಆಟದ ನಂತರ ಇಡೀ ಕೋಣೆ ತಿರುಗುಮುರುಗು ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the game, the whole room was in a state of being reversed (upside down).

definition: to become wise; to have wisdom.
example_en: As he grew older, he became wise.

definition: a mind focussed on a single subject.
example_en: If one meditates with a single-pointed mind, the result is attained.

definition: lack of patience; impatience.
example_en: Even a small remark used to bring him impatience.

definition: to make preparations (for); to make ready.
example_en: The army made preparations for the war.

definition: to come, recur for the second time.
example: ಆ ಸಿಹಿ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಇಮ್ಮಡಿಸಿಬಂದು ಸಂತೋಷ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: That sweet news came again, doubling the joy.

definition: manner or mode of expression in language; a style.
example_en: This poet's style of writing is distinctive.

definition: the act of opening one's eyes.
example_en: Seeing the baby open its eyes, the mother smiled.

definition: in or to the rear or at the back; behind.
example_en: In the procession, the band troupe was moving along behind.

definition: a great peril; a highly dangerous condition.
example_en: That decision brought a great peril to the country.

definition: to beat; to strike.
example_en: In anger he struck the door.

definition: an examining or being examined; an investigation, inspection or detailed checkup.
example_en: The committee conducted an inspection of the project.

definition: not entire; of or having to do with only a part; part; loose.
example_en: This is partial information, not complete.

definition: to cause to catch, hold.
example_en: The police caused him to catch the thief.

definition: a right, correct course of action.
example: ಅವನು ಪವಣಂಬಟ್ಟೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ತಪ್ಪು ದಾರಿ ಹಿಡಿದನು.
example_en: He abandoned the right course of action and took the wrong path.

definition: the sage-author of the Hindu Epic Mahābhārata; Maharṣi Vēdavyāsa.
example_en: It is believed that the sage Krishna Dvaipayana composed the Mahabharata.

definition: (fig.) cruel or brutal mind; inhumanity; cruelty.
example_en: People were shocked to see his inhumanity.

definition: pronunciation - a) the act or manner of pronouncing syllables, words, and phrases with regard to the production of sounds and the placing of stress, intonation, etc.; b) any of the accepted or standard ways of pronouncing a word, etc.
example_en: That teacher's pronunciation was very clear.

definition: a very vile woman.
example: ಊರಿನ ಜನ ಆಕೆಯನ್ನು ಅತಿದವಡಿತಿ ಎಂದು ದೂರುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The villagers used to blame her as a very vile woman.

definition: the act of renouncing; renunciation.
example_en: He renounced all his property.

definition: to teach - a) to give lessons to (a student, pupil or class); guide the studies of; to instruct; b) to give lessons in (a subject) to someone; to help someone to develop (a skill or trait).
example_en: The grandmother taught sewing to her granddaughter.

definition: not adulterated; unmixed; pure; unimpaired; untainted.
example: ಈ ಚಿನ್ನ ಚೊಕ್ಕವಾಗಿದೆ, ಯಾವ ಕಲಬೆರಕೆಯೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
example_en: This gold is pure, with no adulteration at all.

definition: to draw out or spin a yarn or thread from wool, cotton, etc.
example_en: She spun yarn from cotton and wove cloth.

definition: a kind of.
example_en: They prepared the chambe during the festival.

definition: a water vessel, propelled with an oar or oars; a boat.
example_en: The fisherman rowed the boat with an oar.

definition: a herd of elephants.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಆನೆಗದುಪು ನೀರಿನ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಹೊರಟಿತು.
example_en: A herd of elephants in the forest headed towards the water.

definition: forbearance, leniency or mercy, as toward an offender or enemy.
example_en: The king granted mercy to the enemy.

definition: a cooking (of something) in milk.
example_en: Grandmother prepared rice cooked in milk.

definition: the side portion of the body from the armpit to the waist.
example_en: There was a large wound on the side of his body from the armpit to the waist.

definition: small amount of money (often, collectively, coins of small denominations one has).
example_en: There was only a small amount of change in his pocket.

definition: manual work; physical exertion.
example_en: He grew tired doing manual work in the field.

definition: a single fold (of a cloth, paper etc.).
example_en: She folded the cloth into a single fold.

definition: a baseless accusation or vilification.
example_en: The people's baseless accusation hurt her.

definition: a bald head.
example_en: He applied oil to his bald head and sat in the sun.

definition: the tree Diospyros peregrina (= D. embryopteris, = D. glutenifera) of Ebenaceae family.
example_en: There was a big jagala tree outside the village.

definition: a jacket or bodice that can be tied to the body.
example_en: The grandmother tied the jacket onto the baby.

definition: the quality, condition or fact of shining by reflected light; gloss; sheen; lustre.
example_en: Lightning flashed brightly in the cloud.

definition: a large number of things gathered, collected together.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಹಳೆಯ ವಸ್ತುಗಳ ಗುಮ್ಮಿ ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A large collection of old things lay in front of the house.

definition: a house providing facilities for travellers to stay for a short period.
example_en: We booked a room at the travellers' rest house.

definition: the extent, dimensions, capacity, etc. of anything, esp. as determined by a standard.
example_en: The capacity of the tank is a thousand liters.

definition: (gram. a heterogenous compound) Śiva, who wears a garland of skulls.
example_en: The devotees worshipped Shiva, who wears a garland of skulls, with devotion.

definition: the fact of or relation resulting from interclass marriage.
example: ಅವರ ಮಗಳ ವರ್ಣಸಂಕರತೆ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚೆಯ ವಿಷಯವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Their daughter's inter-caste marriage became a topic of discussion in society.

definition: to become dark or darker.
example_en: When the sun set, the forest became dark.

definition: an apparatus with a central pivot, beam (with a fulcrum at the centre), and two scales used for weighing; a balance.
example_en: The shopkeeper weighed the rice on the balance.

definition: to adapt for performance; to be engaged in the theatrical performance.
example: ನಾಟಕದ ಕೊನೆಯ ದೃಶ್ಯವನ್ನು ಅಭಿನಯಗೂಡಿಸಲು ಅವರು ರಾತ್ರಿಯೆಲ್ಲಾ ಪರಿಶ್ರಮಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They worked hard all night to adapt the last scene of the play for performance.

definition: a red-coloured ant.
example_en: Red ants were moving about in a group at the foot of the tree.

definition: to grow less; to diminish.
example_en: Gradually his fever grew less.

definition: three quarters of a whole; ¾.
example_en: Three quarters of the rice still remained in the sack.

definition: a discharging, sacking of being discharged, sacked (from one's office, employment, etc.); a dismissal.
example_en: He was suddenly dismissed from the office.

definition: the act or an instance of making a sound or series of sounds.
example_en: The singer's act of producing sound enchanted the audience.

definition: to make (something) become cool or cooler.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಬಿಸಿ ಹಾಲನ್ನು ತಣಿಸಿ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: Mother cooled the hot milk and gave it to the child.

definition: in a straight manner.
example_en: He showed the way in a straight manner.

definition: to have name; to be known by one's name.
example_en: That hero became known through the war.

definition: to comprehend, understand correctly.
example_en: I could not correctly understand the meaning of his words.

definition: (dial.) to tie or pack (something) securely or firmly.
example_en: He tied the sack securely.

definition: the creeper Cardiospermum halicacabum of Sapindaceae family.
example_en: The irumballi creeper had spread over the fence.

definition: the state or condition of being puzzled, confused; a situation that is very complicated, problems in which are hard to untangle, understand, analyse, etc.
example_en: There was a great confusion in that calculation.

definition: the act of cutting, breaking into pieces.
example_en: His hand was injured by the cutting of the wood.

definition: a large quantity or number; a mass.
example_en: A huge mass of people was thronging at the fair.

definition: an estate, property or wealth etc. of a person inherited by his or her own son or sons.
example_en: That inherited wealth went to the son.

definition: placed below or on the ground.
example: ಆ ಶಿಲೆ ನಿಭೃತವಾಗಿ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That stone lay placed on the ground.

definition: a liberal bestower.
example: ಆ ಸುದಾಮ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಹೇರಳವಾಗಿ ದಾನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That liberal bestower gave generously in charity to the poor.

definition: a step in going backard or retreat.
example_en: He took a step backward before the enemies.

definition: a daughter of one's sister.
example: ಅವಳು ನನ್ನ ಸೋದರಸೊಸೆ, ನನ್ನ ತಂಗಿಯ ಮಗಳು.
example_en: She is my niece, my sister's daughter.

definition: a man who indulges excessively in extra-marital sexual relations; a debauchee.
example: ಹರಳನಾದ ಅವನು ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾರಿಗೂ ಗೌರವ ಕೊಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Being a debauchee, he gave respect to no one in the town.

definition: to speak slightingly of; show disrespect for.
example: ಯಾರನ್ನೂ ಕೀಳುನುಡಿಯಬೇಡ, ಅದು ನಿನ್ನ ಗೌರವವನ್ನೇ ಕುಗ್ಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Do not speak slightingly of anyone; that only lowers your own dignity.

definition: a kind of percussion instrument (that has a membrane stretched tightly over and played by beating).
example_en: The sound of the chammala in the procession was heard far away.

definition: to wander or roam about.
example_en: She wandered about alone in the darkness.

definition: (masc.) a professional snake-charmer or catcher.
example_en: The snake-charmer made the snake dance on the street.

definition: to give an account of; to tell in writing or speech; to narrate.
example_en: He narrated his travel experience in writing.

definition: the attitudes or beliefs of a cynical person; cynicism.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಸಿನಿಕತೆ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Cynicism always shows clearly in his speech.

definition: to become very dense or coagulated.
example_en: Because of the cold, the oil became very thick.

definition: a person in the time of life between puberty and maturity; youth.
example_en: That youth is known to everyone in the village.

definition: a place where building stone, marble or slate is excavated; a quarry.
example_en: Stones are quarried and extracted from the quarry.

definition: division into three parts, groups or classes (which are distinguished from or opposed to each other).
example_en: The property was divided into three parts among the three children.

definition: to become more in quantity, number, degree or inensity.
example: ಮಳೆ ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ನದಿಯ ನೀರು ಬಹಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: After the rain came, the water in the river increased greatly.

definition: the main street in which the procession of temple deity is usu. taken.
example_en: The deity's procession moved along the main temple street.

definition: to cause to become insane or mad.
example_en: That sorrowful matter drove the grandmother mad.

definition: (hist.) a kind of tax.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊದಿಕೆ ಎಂಬ ತೆರಿಗೆ ವಿಧಿಸಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The government had levied a tax called hodike in that village.

definition: devoted love and loyal or zealous support of one's country; patriotism.
example_en: The soldiers' patriotism inspires everyone.

definition: the power of knowing those matters which are beyond the sensory organs and ordinary intellect.
example_en: People believe that the sages had the power of knowing beyond the senses.

definition: a contract by which one party (landlord or lessor) gives to another (tenant or lessee) the use and possession of lands, buildings, property, etc. for a specified time and for fixed payments; a lease.
example_en: They entered into a lease for that land.

definition: (masc.) a jobless, unemployed person.
example: ಪದವಿ ಪಡೆದ ನಂತರವೂ ಅವನು ಅಬ್ಬೇಪಾರಿಯಾಗಿಯೇ ಉಳಿದನು.
example_en: Even after getting his degree, he remained an unemployed person.

definition: a soft, silver-white, crystalline, metallic chemical element, malleable at ordinary temperatures, capable of a high polish, and used as an alloy in tin foils, solders, utensils, type metals, superconducting magnets, etc. and in making tin plate; Tin; (Sn).
example_en: They melted tin and mixed it with lead.

definition: the buying and selling of commodities; trade.
example: ಅವನು ಬಟ್ಟೆಗಳ ಬೇಪಾರ ಮಾಡಿ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He makes a living doing the trade of clothes.

definition: a man of the enemy side captured by an army in wartime.
example_en: The soldiers captured the enemy's war prisoner.

definition: a chopped, hashed piece of meat.
example_en: The cook cooked the chopped piece of meat with spices.

definition: a sort of brazen drum.
example_en: The brazen drum was resounding in the temple.

definition: a stuffed or padded armchair with a lean-back; an easy chair.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ಸಂಜೆ ಆರಾಮಕುರ್ಚಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತು ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಓದಿದನು.
example_en: Grandfather sat in the easy chair in the evening and read the newspaper.

definition: a valorous man.
example: ಆ ಉರ್ಕಾಳ್ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಪಾರ ಪರಾಕ್ರಮ ತೋರಿದನು.
example_en: That valorous man displayed immense bravery in the war.

definition: the plant Withania somnifera of Solanaceae family.
example_en: The doctor used the ashwagandha plant for medicine.

definition: the condition of being comfortable, salubrious; ease of doing or making; absence of difficulty.
example: ಈ ಆರೋಪ ಪ್ರಾಯಿಕವಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳಲ್ಲೂ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This allegation is commonly found in most cases.

definition: a searching examination; an enquiry; a probe.
example_en: The police began an inquiry into the incident.

definition: the quality present in a thing or person that gives intense pleasure or deep satisfaction to the mind, whether arising from sensory manifestations; beauty.
example_en: The beauty of her face captivated the onlookers.

definition: a periodical published once a month; a monthly.
example: ಅವನು ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಒಂದು ಮಾಸಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಓದುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He reads a monthly magazine every month.

definition: a receptacle or holder of water; the ocean.
example_en: The ocean is full of waves.

definition: (does not seem to be a correct compound) to go or shift oneself to a different place.
example_en: He left the town to go and shift to a different place.

definition: the inner sanctuary of Hindu temples where the main idol is installed, and symbolically the birth place of the universe; sanctum sanctorum.
example_en: The priest lit the lamp inside the inner sanctuary.

definition: a brief stay; sojourn.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ನಡುವೆ ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದಿನ ತರಹರ ಮಾಡಿದೆವು.
example_en: During the journey we made a brief sojourn of one day in that town.

definition: the plant Eclipta prostrata ( = E. alba) of Asteraceae family; weed-ham.
example_en: The weed-ham plant had grown on the field's border.

definition: a lustful man; one who is extremely indulged in his appetite for sexual pleasures.
example: ಆ ಅಭೀಕ ಸದಾ ಸುಖಭೋಗಗಳ ಬೆನ್ನು ಹತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That lustful man always chased after sensual pleasures.

definition: the quality or condition of being clear; clearness; clarity.
example_en: The clarity of his speech was appreciated by everyone.

definition: a Muhammadan priest.
example_en: The khaji settled the dispute between the two.

definition: towrds the outside.
example_en: The children ran outside to play.

definition: the temperament of a forest-dweller; lack of refinement, elegance, polish or sophistication; boorishness.
example_en: Because of his boorishness, the villagers kept him at a distance.

definition: an offensive smell or odour.
example_en: An offensive smell was coming from the rotten garbage.

definition: the flesh of the heart.
example_en: The flesh of the heart was used in the ritual offering.

definition: that which causes partial or total loss of the sense of pain, temperature, touch, in the treatment diseases; an anaesthetic agent.
example_en: The surgeons used the anaesthetic agent in the right proportion.

definition: the boundary or border beyond which something ceases to be or to be possible.
example_en: Even patience has a limit beyond which it ceases.

definition: a place where bees are kept for their honey, generally consisting of a number of hives; an apiary.
example: ರೈತ ಜೇನುಮನೆಯ ಬಳಿ ಹೊಗೆ ಹಾಕಿ ಜೇನು ತೆಗೆದನು.
example_en: The farmer smoked near the apiary and took out the honey.

definition: to subject to or purify or refine by, distillation; to distil.
example_en: The craftsman distilled the flower oil.

definition: an arc of coloured light in the sky caused by refraction of the suṇs rays by rain; a rainbow.
example_en: A rainbow arose in the sky after the rain.

definition: to cause to come into physical contact; to cause to stick to; to fix on; to sticker; to paste.
example_en: She pasted the picture on the wall.

definition: a prize, reward given in the form of cash (or cheque, instead of a memento).
example_en: The winner of the competition was given a cash prize.

definition: a kind of large squirrel.
example_en: A large squirrel was sitting on that tree.

definition: the sound made while munching, eating.
example: ಅವನು ಕಚಕಚ ಶಬ್ದ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಸೇವಿಗೆ ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: He was eating the snack making a munching sound.

definition: a preparation used to wash oil smeared (esp. on the head) while bathing.
example_en: The preparation for washing off the oil was ready before the bath.

definition: any article of food; an eatable.
example_en: She prepared a tasty eatable for the children.

definition: the udder (of a cow, buffalo) filled with milk secreted from within.
example: ಹಾಲುಗೆಚ್ಚಲನ್ನು ನೋಡಿದರೆ ಹಸು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಹಾಲು ಕೊಡುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Looking at the udder filled with milk, one can tell that the cow gives good milk.

definition: a swollen, inflamed area in body tissues, in which pus gathers; an internal abscess.
example_en: That patient developed an internal abscess in the stomach.

definition: (only as the first word in a compound) old.
example_en: The old house is still standing firmly.

definition: a woman who acts in consonance with another's desires or wishes.
example: ಇಚ್ಚೆಗಾತಿಯಾದ ಅವಳು ಗಂಡನ ಇಷ್ಟದಂತೆ ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: Being a woman who acted according to her husband's wishes, she did everything as he desired.

definition: in or to a greater degree or extent.
example_en: The sun's heat rose to a greater extent.

definition: the end of the eye that is away from the nose; the corner of the eye.
example_en: Tears had filled the corner of his eye.

definition: to snub another down with movement of one's eyes or brows.
example_en: He snubbed him with a movement of his eyes and made him stop talking.

definition: clothing used gen. by men.
example_en: The shop had various kinds of clothing worn by men.

definition: a proposition that follows from another that has been proved; a corollary.
example_en: A corollary follows from that theorem.

definition: a white, crystalline substance, sodium chloride, NaCl, with a characteristic taste, made from sea water, and used for seasoning and preserving foods, etc.; common salt.
example_en: They brought sacks full of salt in the cart.

definition: an obstacle; an impediment.
example_en: Many obstacles were encountered during the journey.

definition: a young female human being; a girl.
example_en: That young girl came from school singing.

definition: (pl.) the alphabets.
example_en: The child first learned the alphabets.

definition: to move or proceed to, towards or from; to go.
example_en: People were proceeding towards the temple.

definition: the science of numbers; arithmetic.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ಶಿಷ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಅಟವಣೆಯ ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಪಾಠ ಹೇಳಿಕೊಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The teacher taught the students the basics of arithmetic.

definition: to get hallucination cured.
example_en: He got his hallucination cured through medicine.

definition: to bring together; to cause to assemble; to collect; to congregate.
example_en: They assembled all the children in the courtyard.

definition: an oblation of ghee for the Vasus, a class of deities, in a sacrifice.
example_en: The priests offered the ghee oblation for the Vasus in the sacrifice.

definition: a variety of black cobra.
example_en: In the forest, the black cobra stood with its hood raised.

definition: a usu. heavily populated area of a city, characterised by poverty, poor housing, unhealthy condition, etc.; a slum.
example_en: There are no basic facilities in the city's slum.

definition: a sharing of something.
example_en: A sharing of the property took place among the brothers.

definition: to be affected by a rust, as during exposure to air and moisture; to rust.
example_en: In the rainy season, iron tools rust.

definition: to become fat or corpulent.
example_en: Because he eats too many sweets, he is becoming fat.

definition: a sport; an amusement; merriment; gaiety.
example_en: The children were engaged in amusement on the playground.

definition: a small fixed wheel, sometimes turning in a block, with a grooved rim in which a rope or chain runs, as to raise or lower a weight attached at one end by pulling or releasing the rope; a pulley.
example_en: They have fitted a pulley to draw water from the well.

definition: to lose patience; to get irritated from misfortune, pain, delay, etc.
example_en: He lost patience due to the constant delay.

definition: a strong, unpleasant, offensive smell; stink; stench.
example_en: A stench spread from the drain throughout the street.

definition: an interjection used to express pain, agony, etc.
example_en: Ouch, I have broken my leg!

definition: rapid, lively movement (as from or expressing joy); dance.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಹುಡುಗಿಯರ ಲಾಸಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: On the festival day, the girls' joyful dance drew everyone's attention.

definition: a children's play, played with glass marbles.
example_en: The children were playing marbles in the courtyard.

definition: the thistle plant Argemone mexicana of Papaveraceae family; gamboge thistle.
example_en: The farmer pulled the thistle plant out of the field.

definition: the act of coating a surface with a thin sheet of something greesy, sticky, etc.; anointing.
example: ಆ ಬಾಗಿಲಿಗೆ ಎಣ್ಣೆಯ ಮೆತ್ತಿಗೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಜಿಡ್ಡುಗೊಳಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They anointed the door with a coating of oil and made it greasy.

definition: an offering of an animal in propitiation or or homage to a deity.
example_en: On the festival day, they offered an animal sacrifice to the goddess.

definition: in accordance with; as per; conformingly.
example_en: The payment was made in accordance with the agreement.

definition: an application or proceeding for review of the decision of a lower court by a higher one; an appeal.
example_en: The lawyer filed an appeal in the court.

definition: that is to be waited upon or served or obeyed.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ಸೇಬ್ಯರಾದ ಕಾರಣ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಅವರನ್ನು ಗೌರವಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Because the teacher is one to be served and obeyed, everyone respects him.

definition: that day.
example_en: A great festival took place in the village that day.

definition: a man employed for menial works; a servant.
example_en: The servant swept the ground in front of the house.

definition: beaten, struck in retaliation.
example_en: A retaliatory strike was given to the enemies.

definition: to shoot or discharge a bullet; to a fire.
example_en: The soldier fired a bullet at the enemy.

definition: to put (something) aside.
example_en: He put the money aside.

definition: a narrow opening, as between boards; a chink; a fissure; a crevice.
example_en: Air was entering through the crevice in the wall.

definition: a hard, bivalve outer covering, as of mollusks, insects, eggs, etc.; a shell.
example_en: The shell of the egg broke easily.

definition: the act or fact of camping out.
example_en: The soldiers set up camp at the border.

definition: the fact of becoming, happening or being accomplished.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸದ ಆಗು ಮುಂದಿನ ವಾರಕ್ಕೆ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: The completion of this work is expected by next week.

definition: an oblation offered (to a deity to pacify).
example_en: The devotees offered an oblation to the deity.

definition: (bot.) the egg and the two synergidae in the embryo-sac of an angiosperm; an egg-apparatus.
example_en: The botanist examined the egg-apparatus under the microscope.

definition: a rule ordinance regulating something; a regulation.
example_en: The village panchayat brought a new regulation into force.

definition: money paid in advance by a merchant to a farmer for future sale of latter's produce.
example_en: The merchant gave the farmer an advance for the crop.

definition: to become sharp or sharper.
example_en: That knife became sharper and sharper with rubbing.

definition: a very compassionate person.
example_en: That saint was renowned precisely as a very compassionate person.

definition: a wealthy man.
example: ಅರ್ಥವಂತ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಅನೇಕ ಜನರಿಗೆ ದಾನ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The wealthy man donated to many people.

definition: made yesterday.
example_en: This food was made yesterday, do not eat it.

definition: the act of placing foot forward, backward, sideways, etc. as in walking, dancing, etc.
example_en: The dancer's footwork was very beautiful.

definition: existing for a short period.
example_en: That organization's plan was short-lived.

definition: to protrude or project; to bulge; to expand (oneself).
example_en: The brick of the wall protruded slightly outward.

definition: speed or vehemence of an action.
example_en: The horse ran with speed.

definition: the intermediate demonstrative pronoun neuter denoting a thing between 'this' and 'that'.
example: ಉದು ನನ್ನ ಬಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅದು ಅವನದು.
example_en: That thing near you is with me, but that one over there is his.

definition: a strong, powerful man.
example_en: The strong man in the village used to help everyone.

definition: the sound or words uttered by children.
example_en: The child's babbling was sweet to hear.

definition: a man who hems the clothes.
example_en: The hemmer put a beautiful border on the cloth.

definition: to look furiously at.
example_en: He looked at me furiously with anger.

definition: to contend or fight violently with an opponent; to struggle.
example_en: Two wrestlers struggled with each other in the arena.

definition: a representing or being represented; representation.
example_en: Representation was given to every district in the assembly.

definition: relating to a muslim king (or emperor).
example_en: The people faced many hardships under the rule of the Muslim king.

definition: a tube or pipe of clay, concrete, metal, plastic, for conveying water, gas, oil, etc.
example_en: Water was leaking from the pipe inside the wall.

definition: the point toward which something faces, is directed or the line along which something moves or lies; a direction.
example_en: The wind was blowing from the west direction.

definition: to become diluted; to lose thickness or viscosity.
example_en: The butter became diluted in the sun.

definition: mentally agitated or disturbed.
example: ಅಪಘಾತದ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸು ತಲಿಮಿಲಿತವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: His mind became agitated on hearing news of the accident.

definition: the act of determining the probable value, cost, requirement, size, etc; estimation.
example_en: They made an estimation of the cost needed for the house.

definition: a sore on the body having a deep wound.
example_en: That wound did not heal and became a deep sore.

definition: the science concerned with putting scientific knowledge to practical uses in planning, designing, construction or management of machinery, roads, bridges, buildings, etc.; engineering.
example: ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್ ಚಿಪ್ಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಉನ್ನತ ಪದವಿ ಪಡೆದಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: The engineer has obtained a higher degree in the field of engineering.

definition: the state of being crippled; lameness.
example_en: That old man's lameness has still not been cured.

definition: a red rock.
example_en: Red rocks were seen at the foot of the hill.

definition: name of one of the Manus, the forefathers of human generations.
example_en: They say that Revanta was one of the forefathers of human generations.

definition: the condition of being wet, covered with, soaked in water.
example_en: Wetness formed in the ground because of the rain.

definition: a wooden seat with short legs without any support for the back or arms.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಅಡಿಮಣೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother sat on the low wooden seat and rested.

definition: dazzling light.
example_en: The dazzling light of the morning sun blinded the eyes.

definition: (speaking) irrelevantly; impertinently.
example_en: He spoke irrelevantly in the meeting.

definition: to spend; to expend.
example_en: The king expended money for the construction of the temple.

definition: a controlled outlet for letting out water from a reservoir, water-tank, etc.
example_en: They opened the tank's outlet and released the water.

definition: the bird Turdus ginginianus.
example_en: The Turdus ginginianus bird was eating insects in the field.

definition: a turning back; a coming or going back; a return.
example: ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದ ನಂತರ ಅವನ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಾಪತ್ತಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: After a long journey, his return took place.

definition: the act of bending.
example: ಆ ಕೋಲಿನ ಕುಂಬು ಬಹಳ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The bending of that stick was clearly visible.

definition: the ability to use one's knowledge effectively and readily in execution or performance.
example_en: The problem was resolved through his skillful handling.

definition: any of a large number of relatively small waterfowl with a flat bill, short neck and legs, and webbed feet; a duck.
example_en: Ducks were floating on the water in the lake.

definition: any of an order (Psittaciformes) of tropical or subtropical birds with a hooked bill, brightly coloured feathers, and feet having two toes pointing forward and two backward, some of which can learn to imitate human speech; a parrot.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದಿನ ಮರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಹಸಿರು ಗಿಳಿ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A green parrot was sitting in the tree in front of the house.

definition: (preceding a negation) meagerly; to a small extent.
example_en: He had not even the slightest sorrow.

definition: to inform; to bring to the notice of; to convey (a message); to intimate.
example_en: He informed everyone about the matter.

definition: a recurrent disorder of the nervous system, characterised either by mild, episodic loss of attention or sleepiness or by severe convulsions with loss of consciousness, accompanied by convulsions, physical dysfunction, etc.; epilepsy.
example_en: That child suffered from the disease of epilepsy.

definition: a thin, flat or bowl-shaped cake of batter fried in a frying pan; a pancake.
example_en: They were selling hot pancakes in the shop.

definition: to undertake a penance in repentence of a wrongdoing.
example_en: After doing wrong, he undertook a penance of repentance.

definition: the act, behaviour of treating (another) as inferior or regarding with contempt.
example: ಜಾತಿಯ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಣ ಸಿಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದುದು ಕಂಡು ಬೇಸರವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It was saddening to see him being treated with contempt because of his caste.

definition: obsession - a) the fact or state of being obsessed with an idea, desire, emotion, etc. b) such a persistent idea, desire, emotion, etc., esp. one that cannot be got rid of by reasoning.
example_en: She has an obsession with reading books.

definition: that which is long or longer.
example: ಈ ಹಗ್ಗದ ನಿಡಿದು ಮನೆಯ ಅಗಲಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.
example_en: The length of this rope is more than the width of the house.

definition: the act of converting hides and skins into leather and making articles therefrom.
example_en: In leatherwork, hides are treated and bags are made from them.

definition: (pl.) three angles.

definition: relinquishing; sacrificing, renunciative or renunciatory.

example_en: That brutal killer had instilled fear in the whole village.

definition: one who is not independent in thinking, action, etc.

definition: an exact copy; facsimile.

example_en: This picture looks like an exact facsimile of the original.

definition: having windows, openings or perforations; fenestrated.

example_en: This building is fenestrated, so air and light enter well.

definition: a wooden or metal bar to fasten the door or window panel; a latch.

definition: a small pieces, as of metal, scraped off with a file; filings.

definition: absence of heat; lack of warmth: a low temperature.

example_en: In winter, there is a lot of cold in this town.

definition: the act or an instance of threatening or rebuking using harsh words.

definition: (the hair of the body) to become erect as from joy, fear, etc.
example_en: His body's hair became erect from fear.

definition: a flight of steps; a stairway.
example_en: There was a long flight of steps to go to the temple.

definition: hot displeasure; anger.

example_en: Hearing his words, anger rose in me.

definition: (the wind) to blow.
example_en: As evening came, a cool wind blew.

definition: an ornament worn around the ankle; an anklet.
example: ನರ್ತಕಿಯ ಪಾಯಿವಟ್ಟ ನೃತ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಟೆಯಂತೆ ಶಬ್ದ ಮಾಡಿತು.

definition: any of the four equal parts of something; a fourth; a quarter.
example_en: He received a quarter of the property.

definition: deep hatred; hostility; enmity; antagonism.

example_en: There was deep hostility between those two kings for years.

definition: a white crystalline compound, C6H5OH, with a characteristic odour, used as an antiseptic, disinfectant, etc.; phenol.

definition: a term used to proclaim "leave room for".
example_en: The headman is coming, he shouted, asking people to leave room.

definition: lack of courage to face danger, difficulty, opposition, pain, etc.; the quality of being easily intimidated; cowardice.

definition: a calendar month.
example_en: It rained a lot this calendar month.

definition: to wear an armour.
example_en: The soldier prepared to wear armour for the war.

definition: an excited, wild elephant.
example_en: The excited wild elephant ran through the forest breaking trees.

definition: to force or constrain, as to do something; to compel; to insist strongly.
example_en: The father insisted strongly that his son study.

definition: a pance (an oblong, unstitched cloth worn by men round their waist covering the lower part of the body upto the ankles) with a broad coloured border.
example_en: He went to the puja wearing a broad-bordered dhoti.

definition: coaxing, wheedling words.
example_en: She was fooled by his coaxing words.

definition: the act of deducting, retaining, on some account, a portion of the amount from the amount payable.
example_en: A deduction of the loan amount was made from the salary.

definition: a written document.

definition: a more or less cylindrical roll of tobacco cured for smoking, wrapped in a tobacco leaf; a cigar.

example_en: He smoked a cigar after his meal.

definition: to place both the legs together or close to each other.
example_en: The soldiers stood placing their legs together as per the command.

definition: to make something great; to cause to become excellent.
example_en: The teacher's guidance made his character excellent.

definition: showy display; ostentation.
example_en: That actor's showy display drew the audience.

definition: a cluster, a bunch, a collection of hairs, threads, feathers, flowers, grass etc. held or fastened together at one end.
example_en: A cluster of feathers was attached to the crown.

definition: the entire income of a person or organisation.
example_en: The company's total income increased this year.

definition: he who destroys, spoils or ruins; a destroyer.
example_en: That demon grew up to be the destroyer of the town.

definition: the act of leveling, making (the surface of something) level; a flattening.
example_en: A house cannot be built without levelling the ground.

definition: the black portion of the eyeball; the transparent tissue over the front of the eyeball, covering the iris and pupil; the cornea.
example_en: His cornea had become clouded due to the injury.

definition: a state of mental distress; trouble; agony.
example_en: He could not even sleep because of the trouble of the debt.

definition: a man who sells loads (of hay) carrying on the back of an ox.

definition: the state or quality of being young, esp. of being vigorous and lively or immature, impetuous, etc.; youth.
example_en: Her youthfulness earned everyone's admiration.

definition: the organ of sight; the eye.

example_en: Since there was a slight defect in the eyes, glasses were needed.

definition: the act or an instance of moving; movement; a move.
example_en: Everyone noticed his every movement.

definition: having or showing a bad temper; quarrelsome; sullen; irritable; ill-tempered.
example_en: It is even difficult to talk with that ill-tempered man.

definition: a stack of hay.
example_en: There was a big stack of hay in the yard.

definition: the large, evergreen coniferous tree Picea morinda of Coniferae family, that grows upto sixty four metre.
example: ಆ ರಾಯಿ ಮರವು ಅರವತ್ತು ಮೀಟರ್ ಎತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: That spruce tree has grown to a height of sixty metres.

definition: to join (oneself) with another or others.
example_en: The children joined themselves in the game.

definition: any of the herbs used to bring a person under a spell.

definition: of a kind different from others; distinctive, peculiar or unique; special.
example_en: This task was specially entrusted to him.

definition: the act or an instance of shrinking oneself in volume; contraction.
example_en: Due to the cold, contraction appeared in his skin.

definition: tender-heartedness; kindliness.
example_en: Her tender-heartedness won everyone's hearts.

definition: she who guides another or others (in selecting the right path or means, in rectifying the conduct, selecting a career, in achieving a goal, etc.); a guide.
example_en: That female guide showed the newcomers the way.

definition: a minor, unimportant, miscellaneous or menial work.

definition: the reaping of crops; harvest.

example_en: After the wheat harvest was finished, they filled it into the storehouse.

definition: a present, an offering made to a king or a respected person.
example_en: The subjects offered a valuable present to the king.

definition: the quality or condition of being lean, lanky or weak.
example_en: Seeing his leanness, everyone became worried.

definition: a bad, miserable, wretched condition.
example: ಯುದ್ಧದ ನಂತರ ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬ ದುರವಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬದುಕುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the war that family was living in a miserable condition.

definition: very hot; highly heated.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ಯುಷ್ಣ ವಾತಾವರಣ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That region has a very hot atmosphere in summer.

definition: to make a jarring, grating sound continuously.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಪಂಪು ರಾತ್ರಿಯೆಲ್ಲಾ ಭೋರೆನ್ ಎಂದು ಸದ್ದು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The old pump kept making a jarring noise all night.

definition: a master; a lord; an employer.
example: ಆ ತೋಟದ ಪಬು ಕೆಲಸಗಾರರಿಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಕೂಲಿ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The lord of that garden pays the workers good wages.

definition: to strike with the fist; to punch; to box.
example_en: In anger, he punched his opponent.

definition: wide knowledge; scholarship.
example: ಆ ಗುರುಗಳ ಬಿನ್ನಣ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That teacher's scholarship was famous throughout the town.

definition: a woman who decorates; a decorator.
example_en: The decorator decorated the house with colours.

definition: a cry for help in danger.
example_en: She cried out, "Help, help!"

definition: belonging to some particular person; private; personal.
example_en: This house is his own personal property.

definition: the punishment of keeping (a person) in prison; imprisonment.
example_en: The judge imposed imprisonment on the accused.

definition: the diver bird, water crow.
example_en: The diver bird was waiting for fish on the river bank.

definition: any form of wealth employed or capable of being employed in the production of more wealth; capital.
example_en: They gathered capital for the new venture.

definition: the quality or fact of being clean; cleanliness.
example_en: Maintaining the cleanliness of the kitchen is her duty.

definition: the reflux of the tide toward the sea; ebb.
example_en: As evening fell, the ebb tide began in the sea.

definition: the condition of being humiliated, ashamed; humiliation; shamefulness.
example_en: The shame of defeat troubled him greatly.

definition: the state of being student (esp. studying religious subjects, before being married).
example_en: That boy was strict in his life as a celibate student.

definition: a stupid person; a block-head.
example_en: He is a stupid fellow, he cannot learn anything.

definition: the flower bud of Jasminum multiflorum plant.
example_en: The jasmine buds on the creeper are ready to bloom.

definition: a set of two objects (of the same class); a pair.
example_en: That pair of sandals was still new.

definition: that quantity or weight a normal man can carry on his head.
example: ಅವನು ಒಂದು ತಲೆಪೊಱೆ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಹೊತ್ತುಕೊಂಡು ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He came carrying one head-load of rice.

definition: the finger nearest the thumb; the forefinger.
example_en: She pointed the way with her forefinger.

definition: the act, process or work of removing ores, coal, etc. from a mine; mining.
example_en: Mining is the main occupation in that town.

definition: a metal container with a spout and handle for boiling or serving coffee, tea etc.; a kettle.
example_en: She boiled the tea in the kettle.

definition: an interplanetary journey.
example_en: Scientists are dreaming of an interplanetary journey.

definition: the leguminous tree Tamarindus indica of Caesalpiniaceae family; tamarind.
example_en: A tamarind tree has grown large in the courtyard.

definition: cooked rice.
example_en: Cooked rice was offered as naivedya to the god for worship.

definition: to train oneself or another in some skill, trade, etc.
example: ಬಡಗಿಯು ತನ್ನ ಮಗನಿಗೆ ಕೈಪಳಗಿಸಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಕಲಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The carpenter trained his son and taught him the work.

definition: a meditating within.
example: ಆ ಸಂತ ಪ್ರತಿ ದಿನ ಆತ್ಮಚಿಂತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That saint immersed himself in inner meditation every day.

definition: the soft, murmuring sound of pigeons or doves.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಜಾವ ಪಾರಿವಾಳಗಳ ಕೊಡರು ಕಿವಿಗೆ ಇಂಪಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: In the early morning, the pigeons' soft cooing sounded sweet to the ears.

definition: that can be absorbed; absorbable.
example_en: This substance is absorbable by the body.

definition: the tree Ziziphus mauritiana ( = Z. jujuba) of Rhamnaceae family.
example_en: The ghonte tree was full of fruits.

definition: an unwise, foolish man.
example_en: That foolish man lost all his property.

definition: to change one's place; to move; to go, walk, flow, etc.
example_en: The river water was flowing slowly.

definition: (geol.) a rock fragment different in origin and kind from the igneous rock in which it is embedded; xenolith.
example_en: The geologist examined the xenolith inside the rock.

definition: the state of being or fact of becoming prosperous, successful or thriving; prosperity; progress.
example: ಕಠಿಣ ಪರಿಶ್ರಮದಿಂದ ಅವನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಏೞ್ಗೆ ಕಂಡುಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: Through hard work, prosperity was seen in his business.

definition: the plant Cestrum aurantiacum of Solanaceae family; night queen.
example_en: The night queen flower gives out fragrance at night.

definition: to go on a journey.
example_en: He will go on a journey to Bengaluru tomorrow.

definition: the god of demons ; the demonic god.
example_en: The story refers to the demonic god called Ahriman.

definition: to doubt someone to be guilty of something specified (on little or no evidence); to suspect.
example_en: The police suspected that man.

definition: (masc.) a commissioned officer; a commissioner.
example_en: The commissioner visited the office today.

definition: being in the heart (or mind).
example_en: This feeling always remains in the heart.

definition: a kind of tobacco preparation made using jaggery, scent, and an intoxicant.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ಜೇಬಿನಿಂದ ಗುಡಾಕು ತೆಗೆದು ಬಾಯಿಗೆ ಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡ.
example_en: Grandfather took out the tobacco preparation from his pocket and put it in his mouth.
